provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Compare a few options across a few attributes in a compact text table.
use_when: Option comparisons, specs, small lookups where every cell should be checkable.
not_when: Numeric comparisons that deserve a chart, or anything wider than four columns.

parameters.columns: 2-4 items of {label <= 14, align left|right, mono boolean}
parameters.rows: 2-6 arrays of cells <= 16 chars, or <= 13 with four columns (may be empty)

limits: Four columns, six rows; cells hold 16 characters (13 with four columns).
